definition.construct: declared architectural complexity of the failing system
definition.status: a declared, text-derived proxy. It is NOT instrumented, NOT a count of executed agents, and NOT a ground-truth architecture measurement. Every claim about it is conditional on that.
definition.operationalisation: Three binary capabilities are read from the issue text with fixed lexicons. Each counts 1 when the record contains at least one term for that capability; the index is their sum, giving an ordinal scale 0-3.

components.name: multi_agent
components.rule: >=2 distinct multi-agent terms, or >=3 distinct agent-role terms
components.rationale: A single role name can appear in a single-agent project; two orchestration terms or three distinct roles indicate an actual division of labour.

components.name: uses_tools
components.rule: >=1 tool/integration term (tool, function call, MCP, plugin, retrieval, RAG, sandbox, ...)
components.rationale: A tool interface is a failure surface that does not exist in a text-only pipeline.

components.name: uses_memory
components.rule: >=1 state/memory term (memory, checkpoint, persist, state, conversation history, vector store)
components.rationale: Retained state is what makes context corruption observable.

scale.0: no capability declared beyond a single prompt

known_limitations: Under-counts capabilities that were present but not described in the report.
A long, detailed report has more chances to match a lexicon term, so the index can correlate with report verbosity; this is measured and reported.
The lexicons are fixed in source and were not tuned on the outcome, which prevents the index from being fitted to the result it is used to explain.

text_dependence.note: Share of records whose tier is unchanged when only the title and evidence span are read. A low share means the measure needs the full report and is therefore sensitive to reporting completeness.

verbosity_control.note: If rho were near 1 the index would be a length proxy. A moderate positive rho is expected (complex systems get longer reports) but must not be mistaken for the mechanism.
